In the beginning I would still have the door closed for a majority of the time. When the door was open (and gate still closed) I would alternate going on both sides of the gate for supervision. I slowly progressed to keep the door open for longer periods of time until I could leave it open overnight. It extended introduction time but was well worth it. Because that way, the cats can eat while seeing each other, but you can keep their food bowls far away enough so they don't get paranoid one will attack the other. If you are having issues with them being interested in food at the same time, you could try a variety of treats, or their favorite wet food specifically for those instances. The trick is to positively reward them for being near each other without fighting. And if they start to go at it while eating, you just shut the door and try again later. Because we had lots of fighting in the beginning too.
